claim: Six figures are drawn, each from a single named artefact, and every value annotated on a figure traces to a ledger row.
status_note: Regeneration is byte-identical and a test asserts it, so a reviewer regenerating from a clean checkout gets what the paper shipped. Vector PDF and 300 dpi PNG for each.
value: figure1 from t33_recoverability_ladder.csv, rows C3T-03; figure2 from table2.csv, rows C3T-00+STD-04+STD-08; figure3 from figure3_objects.json, rows C3T-06+DEV-02+FIG-02+P3-01+P3-05; figure4 from encoder_only_by_collection.csv, rows C3T-02; figure5 from phase1_variants.csv, rows B-02+B-03+B-05+B-10; figure6 from two_pass_comparison.csv, rows ADJ2-01+ADJ2-02
floor: not applicable, this row describes the figure set rather than quoting a rate
dropped: three figures were specified and are deliberately not drawn: a leaderboard of producing groups, any object-weighted figure where the analysis result is available, and Segmentation net conformance, which is unadjudicated
notes: Reading the rendered output caught five defects no automated check detects, the worst being a hatched rectangle in figure 2 that read as a 100 percent bar and meant the opposite. All five are recorded in results/manuscript/figures.md. Reading the rendered output caught a sixth after figure 3's silent column was swapped: the one-line title ran past the right edge of the frame, which the byte-identical check cannot see. It is now two lines.

claim: A truer exemplar for Figure 3's silent column exists: four analysis results inside the 21 silent cells carry non-MANUAL segments with the identification sequence absent throughout, so the Type 1C condition fires, a name is supplied, and it identifies nothing.
status_note: The swap was made. Figure 3's silent column is now rider_lungct_seg, on the author's decision after this row was recorded, and the three other candidates stay here as the alternatives that were found and not taken. The exemplar it replaced, dicom_lidc_idri_nodules, is entirely MANUAL, so its silence was legitimate and the Type 1C condition never fired in it. All three columns of the figure now declare a non-MANUAL segment, so they differ in what they say rather than in whether they were asked to say anything.
value: 11 of the 21 silent cells are Segmentation Storage; 5 are entirely MANUAL; 4 carry non-MANUAL segments with the identification sequence absent on every one: bamf_aimi_annotations 859 non-MANUAL segments named BAMF-Brain-MR and five siblings, qin_lungct_seg 378 named alg01_run1 through alg03_run3, prostate_mri_us_biopsy_dicom_annotations 189 named PROFUSE, and rider_lungct_seg 58 named with the single character 0
floor: not applicable, this row counts analysis-result cells and not validator findings
dropped: the two remaining Segmentation cells are excluded as exemplars because they carry a complete Algorithm Identification Macro on every non-MANUAL segment, which is recorded at FIG-03; nothing was fetched and no grade was recomputed
validator: none, this row re-reads recorded values
notes: rider_lungct_seg is the sharpest of the four and is the one drawn: 58 AUTOMATIC segments whose Segment Algorithm Name is the single character 0, with the identification sequence absent, ContributingEquipmentSequence absent, and equipment attributes naming dcmqi. It satisfies the condition the standard states and identifies nothing. bamf_aimi_annotations was not chosen because BAMF-Brain-MR reads as a model name to a human even though the rule table has no rule for it, and qin_lungct_seg was not chosen because alg01_run1 through alg03_run3 are blinded challenge labels, which gives non-identification a benign explanation and repeats the trap that MANUAL set.
